title: Endgame status + buy
description: Tier-1 endgame tick: read current panel status, check game-over + gem box, then buy Health then Damage with observe→ensure tab→seek list top→click. Upgrade menus stay open (never retap an already-open tab; never close after buys).
notes: Enabled for Endgame Phase Loop. Relies on detect_panel / ensure_upgrade_tab / seek_list_top. Never retaps an active tab; never issues a close tap; leaves Attack open. Keep humanize_upgrade_loop disabled.

actions.description: Observe the screen first: is the upgrade panel open, and which tab (Attack / Defense / Utility / closed)?
Echo the panel status into the Automations console.
Read the front-center dialog region and infer GAME_OVER vs RUNNING.
If the run ended, stop. Otherwise gem-check, then Health→Attack buys with status checks — leave the panel open.
actions.explain_a: run is over — log it and skip buys
actions.explain_b: run active — gem check, open Defense (if needed), seek Health to top, buy Health, switch to Attack (if needed), seek Damage to top, buy Damage, leave Attack open

on_a.name: game_over
on_a.description: Mark game_over for stats CSV / stop_when.

on_b.description: Opportunistic gem-box check on the status frame (not its own timer).
Tap the gem box only when the ROI looks occupied.

on_b.message: buy path: Defense/Health then Attack/Damage (menus stay open)

on_b.description: Observe panel; open Defense only if it is not already the active tab (retap would close it).
Look at the Defense list: if Health is not on the first row, controlled-drag up until it is (or the list stops moving).
Buy one Health level on the first Defense card.
Brief settle after the Health buy.
Observe panel; switch to Attack only if needed. Do not close Defense by retapping it.
Look at the Attack list: if Damage is not on the first row, scroll up until it is (or unchanged).
Buy one Damage level on the first Attack card.
Final status check — confirm Attack is still open. We intentionally leave it open.

on_b.message: left panel open: tab={upgrade_tab} (human convenience — no close tap)
on_b.description: Confirm we did not close the upgrade menu.
